days.feynman: Explain the three scope-return rules: For Each, Scatter-Gather and Batch On Complete.

checklist: Flow tracing: I can step through any flow and predict payload, attributes and vars after every processor.
Error propagation: I can predict the final HTTP status for every mix of On Error Propagate and On Error Continue across nested flows.
Scope returns: For Each gives back the original collection, Scatter-Gather returns an object keyed by route index, Batch On Complete sees only the summary.
DataWeave: I can write map, filter, groupBy, pluck and reduce from scratch without the docs.
APIkit: I can say which flow and which error handler a given REST call reaches.
Governance: I know when to use an API proxy vs Autodiscovery, and how SLA tiers and Client ID enforcement work.
Structure: I can explain flows vs subflows vs private flows, and Flow Reference vs VM queues.
Two mock exams at 80% or more, the latest one timed.
I re-read the official exam guide this week and nothing has changed.
